title: BN254 pairing inversion: conditional C6 two-large-prime collection sensitivity

claims.statement: For the full BN254 pairing-inversion target, run the published bn254-c6-v43b-pi-lla STNFS construction and replace its full-relation collection by the two-large-prime variant described in proof.md. Conditional on all inherited exploratory premises and the new H-LP premise that this variant preserves the required rank and success while its complete collection, cofactorization, and filtering work is at most 16874/47821 of the inherited collection row and every other charged row remains valid, its expected total work is at most 2^81.210350 reference units, with success at least 0.39. H-LP is not established by the submitted experiments; this claim is a deliberately conditional research proposal, not a demonstrated BN254 attack or a measured score improvement.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the collection-only sensitivity from the published v43b-pi-lla row bounds and the C4 observed row-count ratio. This verifies arithmetic only; it does not test H-LP or production success.
